summary.text: Angelia Graves is a Democratic member of the Senate of Virginia for District 21, serving since 2024. The Senate's member page lists committee assignments including Agriculture, Conservation and Natural Resources, General Laws and Technology, and Local Government.

paragraphs.text: Angelia Williams Graves was born in Norfolk, Virginia, on January 12, 1972, according to the Senate's member page.

The page says she attended St. Mary's Academy, Booker T. Washington High School, Tidewater Community College, Alpha College of Real Estate and Old Dominion University, and lists her occupation as realtor and broker/owner.

The page lists her as a member of the Norfolk City Council from 2010 to 2021, including a term as vice mayor from 2014 to 2016, a member of the House from 2021 to 2024, and a member of the Senate since 2024.
